name: DICTO DPHP (Decagon-Pentagon-Hexagon Polyhedron)
scale_note: UP frame of #38/#39: icosidodecahedron of circumradius phi with corners (+-phi,0,0) cyclic and (+-1/2, +-phi/2, +-phi^2/2) cyclic (twice the edge midpoints of the icosahedron (0, +-1/2, +-phi/2) cyclic, edge 1); T(S) = {x : v.x <= v.v for every corner v of S}. The OG here is the #31 OG at the UP size (corners: the 30 ID corners, the 60 points 2c - v in each ID triangle (c its centre), and 12 apexes on the five-fold axes in the kite planes). This solid is T^4(OG).
credit_note: Credit: DICTO (idea, names); exact computation with Claude (Anthropic).

centre.kind: origin of the paper frame (= the corner centroid)

unit_volume.note: x -> centre + s (x - centre), s = V^(-1/3) with V the exact volume above; cube roots leave Q(sqrt5), so s is symbolic and the corners are decimals (15 places, as elsewhere). Same corner order and faces as above; volume 1.
